Name: Shobach
Summary: Shobach was captain of the host of Hadadezer, king of Zobah. He led the Syrian confederacy against David at Helam and was slain there with the flower of the Syrian army.
KeyStory: Shobach led Syria's last great army against David and fell at Helam.
RelatedPeople: Hadadezer, Son of Rehob; King David
LifeLesson: The captain of a doomed confederacy still dies at his post.
